server.name: gitcafe
server.title: GitCafe
server.description: Read public repository code, issues and pull requests; sign in with OAuth to manage them.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
GitCafe is a Git forge. This connection covers only the repositories and permissions the user approved. Call get_me to see them and when the connection expires. Repositories created later are not included; the user must connect again to add a repository or permission.

These tools read code, history, issues, pull requests, reviews and CI, and manage issues, comments, reviews, pull requests and merges. They do not create branches or commits, push, update a pull request branch, or run CI. To change code, push a branch with git or the Cafe CLI, then call create_pull_request.

When a GitCafe tool fails unexpectedly, misbehaves or lacks something the task needs, tell the GitCafe team with submit_feedback.

This connection's tokens work only for MCP, not the REST API or Git. Authentication options: https://staging.git.cafe/docs/agent-workflows.md#choose-how-to-authenticate
